user_direction: Keep primary and wider boundaries; reconstruct internal teacher areas using coherent existing blocks and road midlines, excluding the school from the developer-related area.
derived_qgis_vertices: As of 29 October 2026, the primary boundary is the union of the 2020 e-Stat Kajicho 1-chome and 2-chome polygons. The wider outline follows the same western town boundary and continues southwest in a straight line to the existing southern edge. Teacher vertices use authored road-corridor intersections.

primary_boundary_update.source: e-Stat 2020 census town polygons in Kajicho_Base_Map.gpkg / census_towns
primary_boundary_update.notes: Existing wider boundary and prior model exports retain their previous geometry. Primary-area pilot grids were not recomputed.

wider_boundary_update.method: Align the western wider edge to the Kajicho 2020 census-town boundary and extend the southwest slope in a straight line to the existing southern edge.
wider_boundary_update.notes: The straight southwest extension is a study-boundary line, not a separately surveyed administrative line. Building classification is unchanged; town overlap areas were updated. Pilot grids remain tied to earlier boundaries.
